### Curtiss-Wright Announces $250 Million Expansion of 2026 Share Repurchase Program and Declares Dividend of $0.26 Per Share for Common Stock


November 19, 2026


DAVIDSON, N.C.


–


**** Curtiss-Wright Corporation (NYSE: CW) today announced a $250 million expansion of its 2026 share repurchase program, which is now expected to result in record annual share repurchases of $710 million in 2026. The Board of Directors has also declared a quarterly dividend of twenty-six cents ($0.26) per share of its Common Stock, payable December 11, 2026, to stockholders of record as of November 27, 2026.


“We are pleased to announce another $250 million expansion of our 2026 repurchase program, as we remain on track to deliver record financial performance and record share repurchases this year,” said Lynn M. Bamford, Chair and CEO of Curtiss-Wright Corporation. “Share repurchase remains a key element of our disciplined capital allocation strategy, underscoring our Board of Directors’ continued confidence in Curtiss-Wright’s Pivot to Growth strategy, healthy balance sheet and strong financial outlook, and our commitment to delivering sustainable long-term value to shareholders.”


This program will be conducted in concurrence with the existing $60 million share repurchase program being executed this year and follows the completion of $400 million in opportunistic programs that were executed earlier in 2026.


In addition, the Board of Directors authorized repurchases, beginning in January 2027, of $60 million in shares via a 10b5-1 program, which is expected to offset potential dilution from compensation plans. Entering 2027, the Company will have remaining open authorization of $290 million.


**About Curtiss-Wright Corporation**


Curtiss-Wright Corporation (NYSE: CW) is a global integrated business that provides highly engineered products, solutions and services mainly to Aerospace & Defense markets, as well as critical technologies in demanding Commercial Nuclear Power, Process and Industrial markets. We leverage a workforce of approximately 9,300 highly skilled employees who develop, design and build what we believe are the best engineered solutions to the markets we serve. Building on the heritage of Glenn Curtiss and the Wright brothers, Curtiss-Wright has a long tradition of providing innovative solutions through trusted customer relationships. For more information, visit[www.curtisswright.com](https://curtisswright.com/) .
